title: FTAI Aviation Ltd. 8-K Filing — Entry into Material Definitive Agreement
summary: FTAI Aviation Ltd. filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026 disclosing that its subsidiary FTAI Aviation Investors LLC entered into a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, establishing a $2.025 billion revolving credit facility maturing April 24, 2031. The facility includes variable rate pricing tied to SOFR with margins of 1.25%-2.00% and a commitment fee of 0.15%-0.30%.
key_points: FTAI Aviation Investors LLC entered into Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on April 24, 2026
Revolving Credit Facility size: up to $2,025,000,000, with up to $50,000,000 for letters of credit
Facility matures April 24, 2031; borrowings in USD and Euros
SOFR-based Term Benchmark borrowings: Term SOFR Rate + 1.25% to 2.00% margin
Base Rate borrowings: Base Rate + 0.25% to 1.00% margin
Guaranteed by FTAI Aviation Ltd. and material wholly-owned subsidiaries; secured by first-priority lien on substantially all assets
